vendor.blurb: China's biggest open-source ecosystem: Qwen opens every size, Wan video is global top two

highlights: 0902 snapshot debuted #1 on Code Arena WebDev (1691), 3 above Opus 5 (Max)
AA Intelligence Index 45; Alibaba says 33 RSI auto-training rounds lifted it from 40
Best non-OpenAI/Anthropic model on Terminal-Bench-Science (12%)
OSWorld-Verified 86.1, above Fable 5's 85.0 in Alibaba's own table
qwen3-8-max.notes: reasoning_effort has three levels: low, medium and xhigh. The open Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B released 8/12 is text-only with no 1M context and ships under a license with commercial thresholds; the hosted version is closed and multimodal.

bench.Code Arena WebDev: #1 at the early-September launch; passed by Opus 5.5 after 9/23

qwen3-8-flash-next.tagline: An early preview of the Qwen4 architecture
highlights: AA Intelligence Index 40, #6 among comparable open models
Only 6B active, SWE-bench Pro 62.5 vs. 53.4 for Opus 4.6 Max
Training cost about 1/9 of Qwen3.7-Plus; up to 8.6x prefill throughput at 1M context
API served as qwen3.8-flash; free on Qoder through 9/30
qwen3-8-flash-next.notes: Licensed under qwen-community-1.0; large-scale MaaS use needs a separate license. Community reports say it runs slower than the same-size 27B on a Mac.

qwen3-8-27b.tagline: The default Qwen for local runners
highlights: AA Intelligence Index 34, #1/142 among open models of its size
Apache 2.0; Q4 is about 17GB, fits one consumer GPU
Spawned many fine-tunes (Holo4, ThinkingCap, Swift), a Hugging Face trending regular
Ternary Bonsai 2 squeezes it to 5.9GB while keeping ~98% of capability
qwen3-8-27b.notes: Reasoning goes up to xhigh. Very wordy (200M tokens of output in evals) at roughly 46 tok/s.

qwen3-8-omni-flash.tagline: Omnimodal agent that sees, hears, works
highlights: Unified text, image, audio and video input; up to ~1 hour of audio/video per request
Sparse MoE built on Qwen3.8-Flash, 74 input languages
Alibaba claims a 26% average gain over Qwen3.5-Omni-Plus across 30 audio/video tests
Official SWE-bench Pro 63.3, AndroidWorld 87.1
qwen3-8-omni-flash.notes: Text-only output; no longer generates speech. No independent third-party evals yet, and the weights are not open. Qwen Office's "enterprise context" relies on this model.

highlights: AA Intelligence Index 29, #88/216
~200 tok/s output, 5x faster than 3.8-Max
Still sold on Together AI and others; suits long-horizon agent tasks
qwen3-7-max.notes: AA has marked it deprecated and recommends 3.8-Max; the whole 3.7 line is closed, alongside Qwen3.7-Plus (6/3).

qwen3-coder-next.tagline: A local coding agent with 3B active
highlights: SWE-Bench Verified 74.2% with only 3B active
Apache 2.0; runs locally on a 64GB machine
Still Qwen's latest dedicated Coder model
qwen3-coder-next.notes: As of mid-August there is no 3.8-generation Coder; coding has been folded into the main line.

qwen3-6-35b-a3b.tagline: A small MoE that fits on a laptop
highlights: Only 3B active; a popular pick for local runs on ordinary laptops
Apache 2.0; the 3.8 generation has no drop-in replacement at this size
Focused on agentic coding; a dense Qwen3.6-27B shipped alongside
qwen3-6-35b-a3b.notes: The 3.8 generation skipped sizes below 27B and between 27B and 125B, so small-model users are still on 3.6/3.5.

highlights: LMArena Text-to-Image 1228, #1 open and #17 overall
Just 4 points behind nano-banana-pro and 11 behind GPT-Image-1.5-HF
Native RGBA transparent output; composes up to 10 reference images
Runs locally on a single 4090; turbo and distilled LoRAs flooded HF trending within a week
qwen-image-2-1.notes: The license changed to Qwen Research License, so commercial use needs separate authorization. The community speculates it was distilled from GPT Image 2, with no evidence.

highlights: First to merge generation and editing in one 7B model, far smaller than the original 20B
Supports 1K-token prompts; Chinese text rendering is a strength
The Pro version once hit #9 on LMArena text-to-image
qwen-image-2-0.notes: Served through Alibaba Cloud Model Studio API. No confirmed word on open weights, so treated as closed.

wan-3-0.tagline: Drop in a slide deck, get a 30-second film
highlights: #1 on AA text-to-video (no audio), Elo 1335
#2 on AA text-to-video (with audio), just 4 points behind Gemini Omni Flash
Up to 30s per generation, twice Wan2.7; reads PDF/PPT/Excel directly
Topped the with-audio video editing arena in August (Elo 1189)
wan-3-0.notes: Public beta from 8/6, formally launched 8/24. Wan's first fully closed flagship, with no weights released. Alibaba admits audio quality and in-frame text rendering still need work.

highlights: One release shipped text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video and editing
6/12 snapshot ranks #7 on AA with-audio text-to-video (Elo 1149)
Up to 15s per clip, with first/last-frame control and multi-reference input
wan-2-7.notes: The full suite launched in early April, with a snapshot update in June. Some outlets call it open source, but Turing Post found no downloadable weights since Wan2.2.

happyhorse-1-1.tagline: Alibaba's dark horse from anonymous leaderboards
highlights: #8 on AA with-audio text-to-video (Elo 1147); version 1.0 was #9
Audio and video generated together, native lip-sync in 7 languages
Up to 9 numbered reference images, well suited to multi-character scenes
happyhorse-1-1.notes: Built by Alibaba's ATH AI Innovation unit, not the Wan team. Version 1.0 topped the video leaderboard anonymously in April before its origin was revealed.

highlights: Apache 2.0; still Wan's newest downloadable weights
The 5B version runs 720p/24fps on a single consumer GPU
One of the most mature open video base models in ComfyUI, with a huge LoRA ecosystem
wan-2-2.notes: Community tests rank open image-to-video as MiniMax H3 > LTX-2.5 > Wan2.2; newer open models have overtaken it.
wan-2-2.params: 27B MoE (high/low-noise dual experts); also a dense TI2V-5B

qwen-image-3-0-pro.tagline: Alibaba's closed flagship, a newspaper in one go
highlights: LMArena Text-to-Image 1256, #11, tied with Seedream 5.0 Pro
AA Text-to-Image #14 (1088), AA Image Editing #17 (1077)
~4.5K-token prompts render whole newspapers, storyboards and infographics in one pass
Alibaba claims text rendering in 12 languages, down to roughly 10px
qwen-image-3-0-pro.notes: Launched 7/21 as an invite-only API and opened up fully in early August. Unlike 2.x, no open weights, tech report or official benchmarks. Not in LMArena's top 25 for editing.

highlights: AA Text-to-Image #16 (1074), above Qwen-Image-2.1
AA Image Editing #24 (1053)
Flat $0.03/image and 20 RPM, 4x Pro's rate limit
qwen-image-3-0.notes: Same as Qwen-Image-3.0-Standard; not in LMArena's top 25. Closed API.
